tips_en: Start with the DisCo paper (Paper 1) on skill-powered ML research agents—its clear framing of the 'operational knowledge' gap and striking 134.3% gain on MLE-bench make it the most immediately actionable read. It pairs naturally with the EarlyEval paper (Paper 3), since both target LLM agent workflows: DisCo makes agents more capable while EarlyEval makes evaluating them dramatically cheaper. The SolarWM paper (Paper 2) on interactive video world models is more self-contained and best read separately.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读第一篇关于技能驱动的机器学习研究智能体（DisCo）的论文——它清晰提出了"操作知识"这一关键缺口，并在 MLE-bench 上实现了 134.3% 的显著提升，是最具有实践启发性的工作。该论文与第三篇 EarlyEval 紧密关联，二者都聚焦于大语言模型智能体工作流，DisCo 提升智能体能力，而 EarlyEval 大幅降低其评测成本。第二篇 SolarWM 涉及交互式视频世界模型，相对独立，可单独阅读。
